study_dice: sum TP/FP/FN over all slices in the study, then Dice
main_table: unweighted mean of study Dice; studies with tp+fp+fn=0 are excluded from that class mean and listed separately
empty_empty: Dice and IoU are null and are not averaged. FP pixel count is 0. This matches nnU-Net evaluate_predictions.
empty_gt_nonempty_pred: Dice = 0, IoU = 0, FN = 0, FP = predicted pixels. Recall is not defined on a frame with no GT.

bootstrap.slices: all slices of a drawn study stay together
bootstrap.do_not: Do not pool seeds as extra patients. Do not bootstrap slices as patients.

roc_pr: Only if the npz key probabilities is a real softmax (class axis sums to 1). Pixel probabilities, not argmax masks. If the check fails, do not draw curves.
scope: Locked Dice-Focal, gamma 2, both loss weights 1, foreground oversample 0.5. No class alpha, no VV oversample. Not manuscript section 3.5 full RadialMamba. No recipe C.
order: Back up checkpoint_final, then imagesTs for A and B, then A2 and B2. Do not stop A2/B2 or add epochs or switch checkpoints after seeing imagesTs.
